name: benchmark-scifact
description: SciFact measures scientific claim verification: given a scientific claim and a set of abstracts, systems must determine whether the evidence supports, refutes, or is neutral with respect to the claim and identify supporting evidence spans. It tests models' ability to retrieve relevant scientific evidence and perform fine-grained factual reasoning over scientific text. The benchmark emphasizes interpretability by requiring evidence selection alongside label prediction.
reputation: Well-regarded and widely used in the community for evaluating scientific claim verification and evidence retrieval.
